title: Tree: get_selected() updates after item_selected signal is emited when using select_mode ROW
body:
### Tested versions v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439] v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1] ### System information Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 10 ### Issue description the item_selected signal is emited before the selected_item is updated when using select_mode ROW this leads to issues when trying to get the column (row for some reason is fine) or getting the selected item when nothing was selected before. ### Steps to reproduce 1. create tree 2. change select_mode to ROW 3. attach provided script
provided script (click to expand) ```gdscipt extends Tree class CellMeta: var row: int var col: int var value: String func _init(r: int, c: int, v: String) -> void: row = r col = c value = v func _to_string() -> String: return "CellMeta(row=%d, col=%d, value=%s)" % [row, col, value] @export var dummy_rows: int = 10 @export var dummy_cols: int = 5 func _ready() -> void: item_selected.connect(_on_tree_item_selected) _populate_dummy_tree(dummy_rows, dummy_cols) func _populate_dummy_tree(rows: int, cols: int) -> void: clear() columns = cols hide_root = true # Optional: column headers for c in range(cols): set_column_title(c, "Col %d" % c) # Root and items var root := create_item() for r in range(rows): var item := create_item(root) for c in range(cols): var text := "R%d C%d" % [r, c] item.set_text(c, text) # Store metadata PER CELL (not per item) item.set_metadata(c, CellMeta.new(r, c, text)) # NOTE: function is bugged when using select_mode ROW func _on_tree_item_selected() -> void: var item := get_selected() if item == null: return # NOTE: # this returns -1 the first time any row is selected # because selected is updated after this function runs (timing issue) var col := get_selected_column() # stupid fix to not throw error if col == -1: await get_tree().create_timer(0.05).timeout col = get_selected_column() if col == -1: return # NOTE: # because selected is updated after this function runs the column is false here # when clicking on a diffrent columns var meta = item.get_metadata(col) if meta == null: return print(meta) ```
3. run scene 4. click on any cell (would error when not using the delay) 5. click on any cell in another column (wrong col and right row is printed to console) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [tree_select_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25326191/tree_select_bug.zip)
